description: Capa de abstraccion entre la aplicacion y el grafo de ComfyUI. La app NUNCA referencia IDs de nodo directamente: busca el nodo por su titulo (_meta.title) dentro del workflow JSON y escribe en el input indicado. Si cambias de modelo o de workflow, solo tienes que mantener (o actualizar aqui) los titulos de los nodos relevantes.

defaults.positivePrompt: seamless outpainting of the exact same illustrated scene, continue the existing background art in the same illustration style, same color palette, lighting, perspective and level of detail, extend the trees, sky, clouds, ground, water, mountains and buildings naturally beyond the frame, cohesive single artwork, no new characters, no text
defaults.negativePrompt: trading card, playing card, card frame, card border, picture frame, text, letters, numbers, watermark, signature, logo, symbol, ui elements, collage, grid lines, seams, hard edges, duplicate character, extra character, multiple characters, cropped, jpeg artifacts, blurry, low detail, flat color, plain background, empty background, solid color background, uniform texture, noise, distorted, deformed, low quality
